<br><br>

::: {#hero-heading}

I am a biologist and data scientist, and a Research Associate in the Marine Microbial Macroecology Lab at Dalhousie University. My work combines marine ecology, programming, and data management to study plankton and understand changes in ocean ecosystems.

I currently contribute to Phyto-MAP, a global atlas of phytoplankton observations. I develop R tools and reproducible workflows to collect, clean, integrate, and analyse historical time series of plankton data and other oceanographic variables. I also design tools that support data collection, archiving, and compilation in PostgreSQL and SQLite databases, supporting my research group’s work on marine ecosystems.

[More about me →](/about/index.qmd)
:::
